The Burj Khalifa has a height of 828 metres.
Sky Level is a floor in the Burj Khalifa at a height of 555 metres.

parts.label: a
parts.text:
Work out the difference in height between Sky Level and the top of the Burj Khalifa.
............................................. m [1]

content.html: Work out the difference in height between Sky Level and the top of the Burj Khalifa.
content.text: Work out the difference in height between Sky Level and the top of the Burj Khalifa.

parts.label: b
parts.text:
An elevator takes visitors the 555 metres up to Sky Level.
The elevator travels at an average speed of 10 metres per second.

parts.label: i
parts.text:
Work out how many seconds it takes for the elevator to reach Sky Level.
............................................... s [1]

content.html: Work out how many seconds it takes for the elevator to reach Sky Level.
content.text: Work out how many seconds it takes for the elevator to reach Sky Level.

parts.label: ii
parts.text:
Change 10 metres per second to kilometres per hour.
........................................ km/h [2]

parts.label: c
parts.text:
In year 1, 1.66 million people visited the Burj Khalifa.
In year 2, 13% more people visited the Burj Khalifa.
Work out the number of people who visited the Burj Khalifa in year 2.
..................................... million [2]
